# mxroute_reseller_users (Data Source)

List reseller-owned usernames from one complete successful response. No per-user detail requests are made. Requires a plain reseller provider; impersonation aliases are rejected before any request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_reseller_users" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `usernames` (Set of String) Exact usernames owned by the reseller.
